notes.title: Version 1.2g
notes.content:
[h1][u]Bug fixes[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Big bug fix when the event "Nerd Stash" was triggered while every cabins in the game were on fire. Thanks to Audrax for finding the bug and helping us fixing it.
[*] Small FPS improvements (especially on x86 machines)
[*] Lightning fix in room Sector 2 of floor T|-01
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2f
notes.content:
[h1][u]Bugs corrections[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added security to "action-time" which could become negative and made a bug where the acrycine purifier couldn't be used anymore. Now, even with all researches and all glove upgrades, the action time cannot become negative. Thanks to Shawn (again) for finding this major bug
[*] Graphical options are now saved everytime the player exits the options. It does not solve all problems related to loading graphical options, but it's a beginning.
[*] Debug posters that could be null in cabin. There already was a security for this so it didn't broke anything, but now there shouldn't be any more null poster in the game.
[*] Added even more debug messages to help find bugs in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2e
notes.content:
[h1][u]Bugs corrections[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] The research panel of R-14 now appears correctly in one of the two secondary labs of the ship. Thanks to Shawn for finding this major bug
[*] Debug sounds in main menu that were repeating way too fast
[*] Added some debug messags to possibly help in the future
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2d
notes.content:
[h1][u]Bug fixes[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Massive FPS improvements (Special thanks to nor7hy5)
[*] The researches "Positive thinking" 1 & 2 don't require the object "salad oil" anymore, which you can not find in any container (thanks again nor7hy5)
[*] Removed a bug where temperature was not calculated correctly if you had an advanced research "Cooler Potency"
[*] Removed a bug where the event "Data corruption" could indeed corrupt a save file by removing process from an already finished research. An event name has never been so real! ((thanks to...you guessed it...nor7hy5)
[*] Multiple "stuck zones" have been modified to avoid player being stuck. Most of them were found by nor7hy5
[*] The roof of R59-Communication Room has been remade in order to avoid a graphic glitch.
[*] The restart can now be returned from by using the cancel (espace) key without bugging the interface.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2c
notes.content:
[h1][u]Additions[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] There are 2 new panels in R54-Communication Room : you now have a summary of all fires and all hull-breaches of the ship. Good place to look at when you don't know where to start a busy day! These panels will not show up in hardcore mode!
[/list]
[h1][u]Improvements[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] The temperature console has been improved. There are a lot of informations you can gather by understanding what is displayed on the upper console.
[*] The pressure console has been improved too! Hint : for humans, 1013 hPa is the perfect atmosphere pressure.
[*] The saves files format has changed from ".hull" to ".die". The switch will be completely invisible for players.
[/list]
[h1][u]Bug fixes[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reactivated the main menu "UI activate" sounds which were missing.
[*] Fixed some interface buttons had wrong text color when switching from menu to menu in some panels.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix version 1.2b
notes.content:
[h1][u]Improvements[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Massive optimization of frames per seconds by deleting a bugged gameobject that made the FPS drop every time the player moved the camera.
[/list]

notes.title: QuickFix version 1.2a

[list]
[*] The misplaced minimaps are now fixed.
[*] The T|00 minimap had an incorrect "big teleporter" position. This is fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Version v1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Following the difficulty update, now we offer you a new ending.[/h1]

[h1][u]Improvements[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] The endgame "crash" is now fully functional.
[*] 2 new leaderboards (1 hardcore and 1 easy) for the crash ending. These leaderboards are in reverse order of time of survival, meaning the longer you take to crash the lower your rank will be. It will also automatically submit to the "regular" leaderboard just in case.
[*] "Development build" is now off on LINUX version (and hopefully it's stable).
[/list]

[h1][u]Additions[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an informative message when a player dies because health reach zero. The new message displayed on the death screen now reveals the probable cause(s) of the death.
[/list]

[h1][u]Bug Fixes[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Save/Load system shoud no longer hang indefinetly, preventing the player to make another save and/or crashing at load.
[/list]

[h1]To eternity and beyond! Or not.[/h1]

notes.title: Patch note v1.1. Have a good summer in the cold of space!
notes.content:
[b]Patch note v1.1. Have a good summer in the cold of space![/b]

[h1][u]Additions[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] New "easy" mode. In fact, this mode is now considered normal whereas the "old" saves and profiles are now displayed as "hardcore". This new mode has a separate leaderboard. This mode has a lot of small changes to make your survival easier, but the main one is the addition of the brand new "Dynamic maps system" (Copyright SecSystem)
[*] New "Dynamic maps system"! You can now see all discovered rooms being displayed on the maps placed on the walls of the different floors. So you no longer have any excuse to not remember where this damn Repair Room is!
[*] New leaderboard to make the distinction between the hardcore and "easy" mode.
[/list]

[h1][u]Improvements[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] NVidia users now have a small optimization for displaying massive fires FX.
[*] The display of acrycine clouds is now capped so this should also relieve the graphics card a little.
[*] The texture of the heat effect is now 4 times bigger, and against all odds it's also easier for the graphic cards to loop it.
[/list]

[h1][u]Bug Fixes[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Wounds and diseases who are not supposed to be able to evolve 2 stages in a single night are now strictly forbidden to do so (yes it was possible, if you had a very bad luck, to have a chain reaction between diseases making them crippling/deadly in a very short time).
[*] The loading of objects in rooms has been made so that now, when you load a saved game, it is impossible to restore a consumed object.
[*] Interface in the loading panel should no longer turn pink when a load error occured.
[*] All saves are now scanned when loading the loading panel, so a corrupted save can no longer slip through the cracks.
[*] The voices can no longer slow down during the fade-in of the night.
[*] Clean and refactor a lot of code. Also removed some old useless relics. May or may not improve the performances, but cannot hurt.
[/list]

Free demo available on Steam

notes.title: Patch note v1.0 - Release
notes.content:
[img]http://nsa38.casimages.com/img/2016/12/14/mini_161214121200910912.png[/img]

[b]Patch note v1.0[/b]

[h1][u]Additions[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*]Lots of new voices!
[*]New achievements.
[*]Steam Trading Cards.
[*]New story text.
[*]New sounds for the Objectives End Game.
[*]Breaches will now display a repair panel like the broken objects.
[*]New light for the emergency button in R22.
[/list]
[h1][u]Improvements[/u] :[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced difficulty.
[*]Lots of objects that could be used multiple times will now only be usable once : deodorant, alcohol70°, bad cold medecine, bruise cream, headache pills, indigestion pills, inhibitors and medkits.
[*]Deodorant bonus is now +45 morale.
[*]Medkit bonus is now -6 to the disease or wound severity.
[*]When a food is placed in the scraper, it should not be altered anymore and the scraper will just give the exact same item.
[*]Changed the way the voice tuto works. No more random when picking a line.
[*]Rebaked lightings of R05, R05 bis, R33 and corridors.
[*]Changed the Juice Extractor panel.
[*]Added alpha to the panels of EscapePods.
[*]Changed highlight behaviour for restart button after death.
[*]Added little colliders on top of Air Recyclers.
[*]Changed text of Roots Productions Screens.
[*]Added filters to IA voice.
[*]Changed some texts to fit better in the Log.
[*]Teleporters Repair Panel should appear more easily now.
[*]No more "awake from bed" animation.
[*]No more undies in bathrooms of cabins.
[*]Seats of R22 and R54 now have a voice tuto.
[*]A lot more bioresin in Storage Bays.
[*]More medecines in holoshelf of R09 and R27.
[*]More moral objects in shelf of R05-cabins.
[*]Changed stinger for New Game.

[*]Fire will now increase temperature 5 times faster (0.5 °C per second)
[*]Changed repair sound.
[*]Acrycine makes you loose life 40% faster.
[*]The breathing speed of acrycine has been diminished a little.
[*]Base weight you can carry is now 250 (instead of 400)
[*]Minimum weight the player can carry is now 100 (instead of 200).
[*]Small Vibrating Stick will no longer give cable when placed in the scraper
[*]Inputs layout changed : "Take full stack" and "Take half stack" are now placed under "Transfer Object" for easier readability.
[*]Changed values for research Decay Prevention. Now uses more Process.

[b]Patch note v0.92:[/b]

[*]Fixed Decal Auxilliary Air Recycling
[*]Emissive fixed in R42 for console and machines.

[*]Fixed 3 occlusion bugs à T-01 and T-02
[*]Fixed doors around R12 and R13 for their orientation to prevent a door from sliding inside a room.
[*]10 missing colliders on walls have been replaced.
[*]Debugged message of body scanner. Health display in log should be correct.
[*]Renamed keys for teleporters (removed the "Alpha" of "Alpha1" so now it is just "1");
